entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet format should support custom build configurations #50115
  • MAUI .NET restores fail in CI after 9.0.8 release #50113
  • [dotnet run][Regression] Message about launchSettings.json is no longer produced #50111
  • "dotnet tool install" and "dotnet <toolname>" inconsistent treatment of paths and DOTNET_ROOT #50110

Closed

  • Verify if `dotnet test` for MTP should propagate DOTNET_ROOT similar to dotnet run #48060
  • dotnet build exit with a success exit code = 0 on build failure #16241
  • Print clear informational message when `launchSettings.json` is used by `dotnet test` #49713
  • dotnet test error MSB4181: The "Microsoft.TestPlatform.Build.Tasks.VSTestTask" task returned false but did not log an error #13431
  • Update xunit templates from 2.9.2 to 2.9.3 #50104
  • `AppendAssemblyResult` doesn't seem to handle the case of "zero tests run" #49753
  • dotnet test doesn't forward build command line options correctly #44655
  • The package reference Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WebAssembly.Pack version has changed from [9.0.8, ) to [9.0.7, ).The packages lock file is samte with LLink #50053
  • xunit - Vulnerabilities #22178
  • Enable Consistent NativeAOT Development Experience with Build-Time AOT Compilation Support #49967
  • The "EnableUnsafeBinaryFormatterSerialization" build setting is defaulting to True for WinForms projects #49956

PullRequests

Created

  • Include localPath in deps.json for runtime assets #50120
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'main' #50119
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.3xx' #50118
  • Update xunit templates to xunit.v3 #50117
  • [Accessibility] Update the .NET logo #50116
  • ensure that the run commands operates on minimal verbosity by default #50114
    Area-CLI, Area-Run
  • Add architecture validation for dotnet test with UseAppHost=false in MTP #50109
  • Add better error messages for dotnet test with file/directory arguments in both VSTest and MTP #50108
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #50101

Merged

  • Mimic dotnet run handling of DOTNET_ROOT in dotnet test #50047
    Area-dotnet test
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0.1xx #50087
  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0.3xx #50086
  • Switch back to using the unofficial templates for PRs #49904
  • Print informational message for usage of launchSettings.json in dotnet test #50112
  • Update xunit templates from 2.9.2 to 2.9.3 and xunit.runner.visualstudio to 3.1.3 #50105
  • Improve AppendAssemblyResult #50057
    Area-dotnet test
  • Better handling of `--results-directory` #50081
    Area-dotnet test, Area-CLI
  • dotnet test doesn't forward build command line options correctly #50084
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #50103
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.3xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #50077
    Area-Containers

Updated

  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Implementing dotnet pack with nuspec files #49813
    Area-CLI
  • [Razor] Generate embedded ValidatableTypeAttribute inline during build for .razor files #50083
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50073
    Area-CodeFlow
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0.3xx #50088
  • Update our container images to ones that are in support #49942
